title: Purity of extremal rays of Betti cones
summary: Let $R$ be a standard graded algebra over an infinite field $\mathsf k$, and let $\mathbb{B}_{\mathbb{Q}}(R)$ and $\mathbb{B}_{\mathbb{Q}}^{\mathrm{pure}}(R)$ denote the rational cones spanned by the Betti tables of all finitely generated $R$-modules and of those with pure resolutions, respectively. We establish several necessary conditions for the equality $\mathbb{B}_{\mathbb{Q}}(R) = \mathbb{B}_{\mathbb{Q}}^{\mathrm{pure}}(R)$.
